 Outlook Germie Bernard 
 Germie Bernard at Cincinnati — Flex Upside in a High-Scoring Primetime Matchup 
 Bernard enters healthy after Pittsburgh stood pat at the trade deadline, showing faith in the rookie's growth while awaiting the eventual return of Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson. Working alongside DK Metcalf, Bernard has drawn steady secondary targets in back-to-back games, and Sunday night's clash between 6-2 division rivals carries strong shootout potential, especially if questionable tight end Pat Freiermuth sits.
 Our weekly projection lands near 10.1 PPR points on roughly four catches and 37 yards, keeping him firmly on the flex radar. Rostered in over 80% of leagues with rising start rates, Bernard profiles as a viable PPR flex play against Cincinnati's pass defense, though modest recent yardage keeps his weekly floor in check.

 Outlook Travis Etienne 
 Travis Etienne vs CAR at home: returning off IR in expected high-scoring matchup 
 Activated from injured reserve on Saturday after recovering from a hamstring injury, Etienne is expected to play at home against the Panthers in a projected high-scoring dome matchup. He returns to a shared backfield alongside Alvin Kamara and Audric Estimé, while recent absences for offensive line starters Erik McCoy and Taliese Fuaga could hurt New Orleans' rushing efficiency.
 Our weekly projection remains at zero points following his late activation, so come back often for the latest news and updates before kickoff. While 94% of leagues roster Etienne, only 17% are starting him, signaling managers view him as a stash right now. After producing nearly 180 scrimmage yards without a touchdown across three early-season games, he profiles as a risky flex option in a favorable matchup.
